_comment: PACER ablation: per-landmark ERE gating (gating=landmark). Same percentile curriculum as image-level PACER, but the gate is applied to individual landmarks (each (sample, landmark) admitted by its own ERE) instead of whole images by mean ERE. Default = DHA (hand), 5-shot, 4-stage (paper Tab. 'per-landmark vs image-level'). Vary num_stages/initial_labeled for the full sweep.
